skills.name: Functions of food and dietary guidelines

worked_example.problem: Every day Nkeng drinks two bottles of sweet soft drink and eats no fruit. Which two dietary guidelines should Nkeng follow?
steps: Soft drinks contain a lot of sugar: eat and drink less sugar.
No fruit means few vitamins: eat plenty of fruit and vegetables.
worked_example.answer: Drink less sugar; eat plenty of fruit and vegetables.

cards.idea: Food gives energy, builds and repairs the body, protects against disease and keeps us warm. It also brings people together.
example: A wedding feast is a social use of food.

cards.idea: Dietary guidelines are advice for healthy eating: variety, plenty of fruit and vegetables, less salt, sugar and fat, clean water, regular meals.
example: Breakfast gives energy for morning lessons.

cards.idea: Food and nutrition is linked to other subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Agriculture, Health education and Physics.
example: Agriculture teaches how food is grown; Biology teaches how the body uses it.

check.prompt: Which subject teaches how crops are grown for food?

wrong.explain: Geography studies the land; Agriculture teaches how crops are grown.

right.text: Eat plenty of fruit and vegetables.

wrong.text: Eat as much sugar as you like.

Regular meals keep your energy steady.

wrong.text: Eat only one kind of food.
wrong.explain: One food cannot give all the nutrients.

wrong.text: Add plenty of salt to every meal.
wrong.explain: Too much salt is bad for the heart.

wrong.text: Fried food is best every day.
